title: Mastering Foregrounding: e.e. cummings
passage:
pity this busy monster, manunkind,
not. Progress is a comfortable disease:
your victim (death and life safely beyond)
plays with the bigness of his littleness
--- electrons deify one razorblade
into a mountainrange; lenses extend
unwish through curving wherewhen till tomorrow
will be yesterday; goodbye billions etcetera

we doctors know
a hopeless case if—listen: there's a hell
of a good universe next door; let's go
hint: ابحث عن كلمات مخترعة، وتناقضات في المعنى، وتكرار في البنية القواعدية.

tasks.instructions: Analyze this poem for all levels of foregrounding (Deviation, Parallelism, Repetition).

correctAnswers.explanation: Lexical deviation (Neologism): Blending 'mankind' with 'unkind' to create a new word that satirizes humanity.
Semantic deviation (Oxymoron/Paradox): The conflicting association of 'comfortable' with 'disease'.
Semantic deviation: A paradox highlighting the insignificance of human achievements.
Graphological deviation: Removal of the space between two words to create a visual and lexical blend.
Lexical deviation: Compounding of two adverbs into a single noun-like entity.
Lexical deviation: Using a prefix 'un-' with a noun 'wish' to create an innovative lexical item.

title: Prose Cohesion Analysis
passage: The main course was dried lamb chops, dried mashed potatoes, and tinned spaghetti in tomato sauce. Cassandra, leaning across to address her brother, entangled her dangling crucifix in the spaghetti. It had to be wiped clean. She did so with a napkin, while he just watched. Both were silent, but the tension was thick. Eventually, they finished the meal and left the room.
hint: تتبع الضمائر (It, She, He, Both, They) وحدد الكلمات المتكررة.

tasks.instructions: Identify all cohesive devices (Reference, Ellipsis, Lexical Repetition).

correctAnswers.explanation: Lexical cohesion through the repetition of the noun 'spaghetti'.
Anaphoric reference: The pronoun 'It' refers back to the 'crucifix'.
Anaphoric reference: 'he' refers back to 'her brother'.
Reference: 'Both' refers to the two characters mentioned previously.

title: The Gricean Maxims Challenge
passage:
A: Have you finished that report yet?
B: I've been working since five o'clock this morning without a break.
A: Where is the stapler?
B: There is a stationery shop around the corner.
A: What do you think of my new dress?
B: The color is very vibrant and the stitching is quite professional.
hint: فكر في كيفية تهرب المتحدث (B) من الإجابة المباشرة.

tasks.instructions: Identify which maxims are being flouted and explain the resulting implicature.

effects: To imply 'No' without saying it directly by emphasizing hard work.
To imply the location of the object by pointing to its source.
To avoid saying the dress is ugly by focusing on technical details.
To provide exactly the right amount of info.

correctAnswers.text: I've been working since five o'clock this morning without a break.
correctAnswers.correctOption: To imply 'No' without saying it directly by emphasizing hard work.
correctAnswers.explanation: Flouting the maxim of Relation to indirectly answer the question.

correctAnswers.text: There is a stationery shop around the corner.
correctAnswers.correctOption: To imply the location of the object by pointing to its source.
correctAnswers.explanation: Flouting the maxim of Relation; B suggests where A can get a new one or where it might have come from.

correctAnswers.text: The color is very vibrant and the stitching is quite professional.
correctAnswers.correctOption: To avoid saying the dress is ugly by focusing on technical details.
correctAnswers.explanation: Flouting the maxim of Quantity/Manner by being overly detailed about minor points to avoid a direct negative opinion.

title: Politeness & Face Management
passage:
Professor: (Entering office) Good morning, can I help you?
Student: Oh, good morning Professor. I'm terribly sorry to bother you, I know you're busy, but I was wondering if you could possibly look at my draft for five minutes?
Professor: Well, I have a meeting soon, but you're such a dedicated student, so let's have a quick look. I love the way you've structured the introduction by the way.
hint: لاحظ محاولات الطالب لعدم إزعاج البروفيسور (Negative Face) ومدح البروفيسور للطالب (Positive Face).

tasks.instructions: Analyze the dialogue for Positive and Negative face threats and strategies.

correctAnswers.text: I'm terribly sorry to bother you
correctAnswers.explanation: Negative Politeness Strategy: The student apologizes for the intrusion on the professor's time.
Negative Politeness Strategy: Using a hedge to minimize the force of the request.
Positive Politeness Strategy: The professor attends to the student's positive face by offering a compliment.

correctAnswers.text: I love the way you've structured the introduction
correctAnswers.explanation: Positive Politeness Strategy: Giving approval and noticing the student's work.
